title: In prepareWindowToDisplayDuringRelayout of WindowState.java, there is a possible permission bypass… (CVE-2026-58934)
description: CVE-2026-58934 is a high-severity vulnerability in the prepareWindowToDisplayDuringRelayout function of WindowState.java. It involves a logic error that may allow a local attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
